title: Open Dunes
concept: Broad low wind dunes with open basins and scattered rocky cover.
difference_from_base: A low-amplitude wind field with interrupted crests; unlike Dune Sea, its default terrain favours open manoeuvring rather than tall dune barriers.
routes: Broad valleys and basins, with existing procedural ramp carving to ensure tank access.
economy: Automatic mirrored economy with three protected opening spots per side; general mex/geo controls supply adjustments.
known_weaknesses: Advanced short spacing combined with high relief can create steep terrain.
core_wishes: Uses the unchanged _wildlands.py helper from the delivered TPL-highlands-1 ticket.
